rules.zh: 使用陳述句語序目標表達【Wh-clause】是嵌入式疑問從句，從句內須使用陳述句語序，而不是一般問句語序。結果會是怎樣，誰也說不準。 客戶會選擇哪個設計，誰也說不準。 然而，如果 who 或 what 本身是從句主語，語序看起來可能與直接問句相同：【It is anyone’s guess who will win.】 誰會勝出，誰也說不準。
rules.en: Wh-clause The wh-clause is an embedded question. Do not use ordinary question word order inside it. Wh-clause It is anyone’s guess what the result will be. It is anyone’s guess what will the result be. Which design the client will choose is anyone’s guess. Which design will the client choose is anyone’s guess. However, when who or what is itself the subject, the word order may look the same as a direct question: It is anyone’s guess who will win.

rules.zh: 整句是陳述句，不是問句接下來會發生甚麼事，誰也說不準。 這句是在陳述某件事無法確定，因此通常以句號結束，而不是問號。
rules.en: It is anyone’s guess what will happen next. The sentence makes a statement about uncertainty. It normally ends with a full stop, not a question mark.

rules.zh: 不表示「任何人都猜得到」這個表達並不是指「任何人都能猜到」。它的意思是「沒有人能夠肯定答案」。
rules.en: “Anyone’s guess” The expression does not mean that the answer is easy to guess. It means that nobody knows the answer with certainty.

rules.zh: 目標表達【“Anybody’s guess”】是可接受變體意思相同，但為保持本課答案一致，所有答案均使用 anyone’s guess。
rules.en: “Anybody’s guess” Anybody’s guess has the same meaning: It is anybody’s guess what will happen. However, this exercise consistently uses anyone’s guess. Anybody’s guess

rules.zh: 獨立使用方式不屬於本課主要答案這個慣用語可以獨立使用，但本課集中練習包含完整 wh-clause 的句式。
rules.en: The expression can stand alone: “What will happen now?” “That is anyone’s guess.” However, this exercise focuses on sentences that contain a complete wh-clause.

rules.zh: 語氣和使用場合這個表達適合用於日常對話、評論、新聞寫作、議論文章及語氣較自然的作文。在非常正式的報告中，remains uncertain 或 cannot yet be determined 的語氣可能較中性。
rules.en: The expression is natural in conversation, commentary, news writing, opinion writing and less formal essays. In highly formal reports, remains uncertain or cannot yet be determined may be more neutral.

benefits.zh: 能清楚而有力地表示無法確定與其只說 I do not know，這個句型能表示並非只有說話者不知道，而是任何人都無法提供可靠答案。我不知道這項協議能否維持下去。 這項協議能否維持下去，誰也說不準。 第一句只表示某一個人不知道；第二句則表示整個情況本身充滿不確定性。
benefits.en: It expresses uncertainty clearly and strongly Instead of simply saying I do not know, this structure shows that nobody has a reliable answer. Compare: I do not know whether the agreement will survive. It is anyone’s guess whether the agreement will survive. The first sentence describes one person’s lack of knowledge. The second suggests that the whole situation is highly uncertain.

benefits.zh: 能準確指出哪項資料不明目標表達【Wh-clause】可以準確指出未知的是人物、原因、時間、地點、選擇、結果、數量或所需時間。機器為甚麼停止運作，誰也說不準。 機器何時重新運作，誰也說不準。
benefits.en: It lets you identify exactly what is unknown The wh-clause can identify an unknown: person reason time place choice result amount length of time. Wh-clause It is anyone’s guess why the machine stopped. It is anyone’s guess when it will start again.

benefits.zh: 能避免重複使用“No one knows” 你不需要反覆使用 no one knows、nobody can say 或 we cannot predict，可以用 be 表達相同的核心意思。這樣可以令說話和寫作的句式更有變化。
benefits.en: It gives you an alternative to “no one knows” Instead of repeatedly writing no one knows, nobody can say or we cannot predict, you can use be anyone’s guess. anyone’s guess This makes speaking and writing less repetitive.

benefits.zh: 能靈活改變未知資料的位置你可以把未知資料放在慣用語後面，也可以把它移到句首，以突出該項資料。
benefits.en: It allows two useful sentence positions You can place the unknown information after the expression: It is anyone’s guess how the story will end. You can also place it at the beginning: How the story will end is anyone’s guess.

benefits.zh: 能成為實用的口語框架記住這個固定框架後，便可以代入不同疑問詞和資料，較流暢地表達無法確定的情況。
benefits.en: It is a useful speaking frame Once you remember: It is anyone’s guess + wh-clause you can quickly build sentences without planning every word from the beginning.

benefits.zh: 適合討論預測及尚未解決的事情這個句型適合討論未來事件、未解釋的問題、缺失資料、未確定的決定、未知原因及尚未得出結論的調查。
benefits.en: It helps discuss predictions and unresolved situations The structure is useful when discussing: future events unexplained problems missing information uncertain decisions unknown causes investigations that have not reached a conclusion.
